features.description: changelog skill at claude/skills/changelog/. Reads a git revision range (--from <ref> --to <ref>; default last-tag → HEAD) and renders a markdown changelog grouped by Conventional Commits prefix (feat / fix / refactor / docs / test / chore / etc.) with a per-group file-change summary and per-commit blurb. Deterministic — no LLM calls during operation; pure git parsing + template rendering. Fixture mode reads tests/fixtures/<name>/git_log.txt instead of running git, so fresh-clone tests need zero git history. Conforms to claude/shared/skill-standard/CONFORMANCE.md. Registered in claude/RESOLVER.md.
steps: Create claude/skills/changelog/SKILL.md with required frontmatter (name, description, trigger_keywords, file_patterns, applicable_agents, phase) and required sections (Purpose, Arguments, Prerequisites, Steps, Output, Examples)
Create claude/skills/changelog/changelog.py implementing parse_git_log, group_by_type, render_markdown, render_json — no I/O outside the documented input paths

Create claude/skills/changelog/tests/ with fixtures covering: nominal commit range with mixed prefixes, range with no commits (empty changelog), range with non-Conventional commits (graceful fallback to 'other' group), single-commit range, range crossing a merge commit, fixture-mode flag
Add claude/RESOLVER.md row with trigger_keywords = ['changelog', 'release notes', 'commit summary', 'what changed']
Run claude/shared/resolver/validate.py — must exit 0 with no NEW errors/warnings (baseline-only acceptable per D007)
Capture evidence: pytest output, validator outputs, sample run output against the nominal fixture
features.acceptance: From a fresh clone, running `python -m claude.skills.changelog.changelog --fixtures claude/skills/changelog/tests/fixtures/nominal/` produces a markdown changelog whose section headings, commit count, and per-group summaries match the recorded golden output byte-for-byte (deterministic given fixture). Empty-range fixture produces an empty-changelog report (exit 0, never a stack trace). Non-Conventional commits fall under an 'other' group rather than being dropped. Tests pass without git history, without LLM calls, without secrets. Skill is registered in claude/RESOLVER.md and validate.py exits 0 with zero NEW issues vs the post-#692 baseline.
